english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something physically higher or on top, including clothing worn over another layer and places farther north on a map.

examples.english: I wear my jacket above my shirt.
examples.traditional: 我件外套着喺件恤衫上便。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gin6 ngoi6 tou3 zoek6 hai2 gin6 seot1 saam1 soeng6 bin6
